verdict.rationale: LightSprint's own pricing page says tasks can be created directly from Linear or Jira with two-way update sync, which covers the core of the story for two of the four named trackers. That support rests on a single thin marketing line, and ClickUp and Monday.com are never mentioned. The generic MCP integrations list does not name issue trackers, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: ClickUp and Monday.com support, documented detail on agents creating or updating tickets in the tracker itself, setup docs for the integrations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can connect issue trackers like Jira, Linear, ClickUp, or Monday.com so agents can manage tickets directly

citations.quote: Create LightSprint tasks directly from Slack, Linear, or Jira. Updates sync both ways
LightSprint tracks all PRs and manages ticket state
